title: Employing Tribe to Study RNA Interactions of Ataxin-2 in Drosophila S2 Cells
author: Shiva Kumar

steps.title: Seed S2R+ cells
steps.instruction: Plate 1 × 10⁶ S2R+ cells per well in a 6‑well plate with 2 mL Schneider's medium containing 10 % FBS and 0.5 % penicillin‑streptomycin; incubate overnight at 25 °C.

steps.title: Prepare TransIT‑X2 reagent
steps.instruction: Bring TransIT‑X2 (MirusBio, cat. MIR 6000) to room temperature and vortex gently.

steps.title: Dilute plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: In a sterile tube, dilute 2.5 µg of plasmid (pJFRC7‑20XUAS‑IVS‑8_ADARcd or pJFRC7‑20XUAS‑IVS‑8_Ataxin‑2‑ADARcd) with 250 µL serum‑free medium; tap gently to mix.

steps.title: Form DNA‑TransIT‑X2 complex
steps.instruction: Add 7.5 µL TransIT‑X2 to the diluted DNA, tap gently to mix, and incubate at room temperature for 30 min.

steps.title: Transfect cells
steps.instruction: Add the DNA‑TransIT‑X2 complex dropwise to the wells containing the growing S2R+ cells, rock the plate gently to distribute evenly, and incubate at 25 °C for 48 h.

substeps.instruction: Optional: co‑transfect a GFP plasmid at a 9:1 ratio or use a GFP‑T2A construct and sort transfected cells by FACS.

steps.title: Harvest cells for RNA
steps.instruction: Collect 1 × 10⁶ transfected cells, centrifuge at 2,000 × g for 10 min, discard supernatant, and add 1 mL TRIzol reagent; invert tube 5–6 times gently.

steps.title: Phase separation
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL 1‑Bromo‑3‑chloropropane, mix briefly 10–15 s, incubate 10 min at room temperature, then centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Recover aqueous RNA phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new tube without disturbing the interphase.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL 100 % isopropanol, incubate 10 min at room temperature, then centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash RNA pellet
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant, wash pellet with 1 mL freshly prepared 80 % ethanol, centrifuge 12,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, remove ethanol, and air‑dry the pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend and assess RNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend RNA in 20–50 µL RNase‑free water, quantify with Qubit fluorometer, and assess quality on an Agilent TapeStation.

steps.title: Prepare Poly(A) beads
steps.instruction: Mix 20 µL NEBNext oligo d(T)25 beads with 100 µL 2× RNA binding buffer, pipette to combine, and incubate on a magnetic rack at room temperature for 2 min until clear; discard supernatant.

steps.title: Wash beads (first round)
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL 2× RNA binding buffer to the beads, mix, place on magnetic rack until clear, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Equilibrate beads
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL 2× RNA binding buffer to the beads and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Bind total RNA to beads
steps.instruction: Dilute 1 µg total RNA to 50 µL with nuclease‑free water, add the 50 µL bead suspension from the previous step, and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Denature and bind mRNA
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 65 °C for 5 min in a thermal cycler, then at room temperature for 5 min; place on magnetic rack until solution clears and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Wash beads (RNA cleanup)
steps.instruction: Wash beads with 200 µL NEBNext wash buffer, place on magnetic rack until clear, discard supernatant; repeat this wash two additional times (total three washes).

steps.title: Elute mRNA from beads
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL Tris buffer (provided), mix, incubate at 80 °C for 2 min, cool to 25 °C, then add 50 µL 2× RNA binding buffer, mix, and incubate 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare fragmentation mix
steps.instruction: In a fresh tube, combine 8 µL first‑strand synthesis reaction buffer with 2 µL random primer and bring volume to 20 µL with nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Fragment and elute mRNA
steps.instruction: Add 11.5 µL of the mix from the previous step to the bead‑bound mRNA, pipette up/down 6 times, incubate at 94 °C then hold at 4 °C, immediately transfer to ice for 1 min (~65 °C), spin briefly, place on magnetic rack, and transfer 10 µL supernatant to a new tube on ice for cDNA synthesis.

steps.title: First‑strand cDNA synthesis
steps.instruction: Combine 10 µL fragmented RNA, 8 µL NEBNext strand specificity reagent, and 2 µL first‑strand synthesis enzyme mix; mix and incubate 25 °C 10 min, 42 °C 15 min, 70 °C 15 min, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Second‑strand synthesis
steps.instruction: Mix 20 µL first‑strand product, 8 µL second‑strand synthesis reaction buffer with dUTP, 4 µL second‑strand enzyme mix, and add nuclease‑free water to a final volume of 80 µL on ice; incubate 16 °C for 1 h.

steps.title: Purify double‑stranded cDNA
steps.instruction: Add 144 µL (1.8×) SPRIselect beads to the 80 µL reaction, mix, incubate 5 min at room temperature, place on magnetic rack until clear, discard supernatant, wash beads twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol (30 s each), air‑dry, then add 53 µL 0.1× TE buffer, mix, incubate 2 min at room temperature, place on magnetic rack, and transfer supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: End‑prep of cDNA library
steps.instruction: Combine 50 µL second‑strand cDNA, 7 µL NEBNext Ultra II end‑prep reaction buffer, and 3 µL end‑prep enzyme mix; incubate 20 °C 30 min, 65 °C 30 min, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Dilute UMI adapters
steps.instruction: Dilute the NEBNext unique dual‑index UMI RNA adapters on ice according to input RNA: no dilution for 1,000–250 ng, 10‑fold for 249–100 ng, 50‑fold for 99–10 ng; keep adapters on ice at all times.

steps.title: Adapter ligation
steps.instruction: Prepare ligation mix with 60 µL end‑prep DNA, 5 µL diluted adapters, 1 µL ligation enhancer, and 30 µL NEBNext Ultra II ligation master mix; incubate 20 °C 15 min. Add 3 µL USER enzyme, mix, and incubate 37 °C 15 min.

steps.title: Purify ligation product
steps.instruction: Add 70 µL (0.7×) SPRIselect beads, mix, incubate 10 min at room temperature, place on magnetic rack, discard supernatant, wash beads twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol, air‑dry, then elute with 22 µL 0.1× TE buffer, mix, incubate 2 min at room temperature, place on magnetic rack, and transfer 20 µL supernatant.

steps.title: PCR enrichment of library
steps.instruction: Set up PCR with 20 µL adaptor‑ligated DNA, 25 µL NEBNext Ultra II Q5 master mix, and 5 µL primer mix; run program: 98 °C 30 s; 8–17 cycles of 98 °C 10 s, 65 °C 75 s; final extension 65 °C 5 min; hold 4 °C.

steps.title: Purify PCR product
steps.instruction: Add 45 µL (0.9×) SPRIselect beads to the PCR reaction, mix, incubate 5 min at room temperature, place on magnetic rack, discard supernatant, wash beads twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol, air‑dry, then elute with 23 µL 0.1× TE buffer, mix, spin briefly, incubate 2 min at room temperature, place on magnetic rack, and transfer 20 µL supernatant.

steps.title: Assess library quality
steps.instruction: Check the final library on an Agilent TapeStation.

steps.title: Sequence library
steps.instruction: Load the PCR‑enriched library onto an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 paired‑end flow cell, set run parameters to 2 × 100 bp with dual indexing, and use the NovaSeq 6000 SP Reagent kit v1.5 following the manufacturer’s setup, priming, and fluidics instructions.

description: Validation of protocol Targets can be validated either through visualization of the gene edit tracks, as represented in Figure 2 , or by using Sanger sequencing. This protocol has been used and validated in [14] (Figure 3 and Figure supplements 4, 5, and 6). The cited figures represent the validation of a strong Ataxin-2 target, 14-3-3 epsilon, using Sanger sequencing and mapping the A-to-G modifications to the TRIBE edits. Data has also been made available publicly and can be accessed on Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO): GSE196739 . Figure 2. Representative edited gene track for Ataxin-2 targets. CG30158, one of the targets of Ataxin-2 identified by TRIBE analysis, shows editing events within its 3′ UTR (represented by blue bars) in the final edited gene track after removal of background and control-derived edits.
